notes: Hoof & Schulz (arXiv:2212.09764) update SN1987A gamma-ray (SMM/GRS) limits on the ALP-photon coupling using temporal information in a Poisson likelihood. Two regimes: (1) ALP-photon conversion in the Galactic magnetic field (J&F model) for ma ~1e-11 to 1e-8 eV, improved by factor ~1.4 over Payez et al. 2015 (rescaled); (2) ALP decay to gamma rays for ma ~10 eV to ~2e8 eV, essentially matching Jaeckel et al. 2018. No numerical table is provided; the data points above are approximate values reconstructed from the described figures (Fig. 3, 95% CL, lambda_P), text benchmarks (e.g. ma=1 MeV, g=2.26e-11 GeV^-1 and ma=1e-10 eV, g=6.55e-12 GeV^-1 both at Delta-chi2=25), and the stated 1.4x improvement over the rescaled Payez limit. Digitized curves are available on the authors' GitHub (sebhoof/snax) and AxionLimits; those should be used for precise values.
